statement: The tooling-versus-reading split is a property of the search key: a token-keyed search finds residue that carries the removed token (R2 red suites, R5 paths, R6 strings); residue whose carrier does not name the removed thing is invisible to it even inside the swept directory (R8); and some classes have no corpus at all (R7, plus R1 which lives only in history).
evidence: measured: grep -rn 'legacy fallback' finds the unclosed alias class in one command
mechanism: the sweep was complete for the classes whose carrier names the removed transport

statement: R8 alias pairs collapsed by a rename: two live documents inside the swept tranche (db-path-policy.md:80, runtime/database/README.md:25) assert that a second spelling is honored while both spellings print identically, and five code sites read the same env var twice. No transport token appears in the carrier, which is why the transport-keyed sweep walked past it.
mechanism: alias knowledge copied per consumer site instead of owned in one table

statement: The same repository already carries the working form of the mitigation: hook-flags.cjs keeps an enumerated LEGACY_ALIASES table naming three generations of names for one concern, with the rule stated (everything a real surface documents is listed so the documented switch actually disables the hook). One owner with a table works; an inline NAME ?? NAME chain repeated per site is the defect-prone form.
mechanism: single-owner alias enumeration versus per-site alias duplication

statement: Classes discoverable before the removal are gates on the removal (R1, R3, R5, R8); classes discoverable only after are steps in a post-removal battery (R2 full-suite run, R6 present-tense read of live operator surfaces, R7 machine-state diff after a harness run).
mechanism: both sides of a rename coexist before the removal, so mistaken decisions are immediately visible; after it they are not

statement: 005 handed the retrieval fixture carrying a retired tool id to phase 7, the fixture survives, 007's summary never mentions it, and 007's scope was the advisor skill directory while the fixture lives in system-spec-kit; the receiving phase could not have acted on the handoff even if it had read it.
mechanism: a handoff whose receiver's scope excludes the handed item

reason: The deleted block's contents are not in the tree at all; the instrument is git history, so the class is a pre-deletion read rather than a post-deletion sweep
